blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$^2$, a framework for recursive harness-policy co-evolution. In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, policy failures guide a coding agent to search complementary Code, Code+ICL, and Code+Policy routes, consolidating verified solutions into reusable skills, routing strategies, and experience memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, verified trajectories provide supervised training, while Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD) teaches the policy to favor successful corrections over failures from the same starting state. The improved policy provides stronger motor skills for subsequent search, while its remaining failures redirect harness evolution, closing the reciprocal loop. Through recursive co-evolution without additional human demonstrations, RoboEvo$^2$ improves standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5% on LIBERO-PRO, with similar gains and reduced agentic costs on RoboTwin C2R. Further experiments demonstrate autonomous task acquisition, cross-embodiment harness transfer, and 95.0% hybrid success on the Unitree G1-D. Our models and code will be publicly released.
blocks.zh: 机器人应当适应不熟悉的环境,通过互动获得新技能,然后通过实践高效地运用这些技能。 视觉语言动作政策提供了高效的控制,但往往需要额外的人类演示来处理不熟悉的环境;推理代理人可以利用广泛的先行知识和机器人控制API来发现解决方案,但反复的考虑与修复费用高昂. 在人类通过推理和实践学习的启发下,我们提议采用RoboEvo$^2美元,作为循环利用政策共同演变的框架。 在"从政策到Harness"(P2H)演化中,政策失败引导一个编码代理搜索互补代码,代码+ICL,和代码+政策路径,将已核实的解决方案整合为可再用技能,路由策略,并体验记忆. 在Harness-to-Political (H2P) 演化中,被验证的轨迹提供有监督的培训,而反事实偏好分化(CPD)则教导政策有利于成功的校正而不是来自同一起始状态的失败. 改进后的政策为以后的搜索提供了更强的机动技能,而其剩余的故障则重新引导了利用进化,关闭了对等循环. RoboEvo$^2美元通过在不增加人类示威的情况下的递归共进,使单项成功率从11.0%提高到84.1%,而混合成功率从30.4%提高到90.5%,RoboTwin C2R的代理成本也随之降低。 进一步实验证明自主任务获取,交叉化活化管转移,Unitree G1-D上的混合成功率为95.0%. 我们的模型和代码将公开发布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Robots should adapt rapidly to unfamiliar environments, acquire new skills through interaction, and execute those skills efficiently with practice. Human learning motivates this progression from deliberate problem solving to fluent execution, while retaining the flexibility to tackle new situations. Current robot systems offer complementary strengths toward this goal. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) [ 15 , 3 , 2 , 45 ] and world action models (WAMs) [ 41 , 11 , 13 ] enable efficient visuomotor control, but remain vulnerable to task and scene shifts [ 46 , 30 ] . Adapting them through imitation learning often requires collecting many additional human demonstrations, making continual skill acquisition costly. Foundation-model agents can draw on broad prior knowledge, reason about unfamiliar situations, and invoke robot-control APIs to discover and refine solutions [ 21 , 10 , 44 , 43 ] . However, repeated reasoning, tool use, and repair introduce latency and API costs that limit reliance on agentic execution for routine behavior.
blocks.zh: 机器人应迅速适应不熟悉的环境,通过互动获得新技能,并以实践高效地运用这些技能。 人类的学习促使人们从蓄意解决问题过渡到流利执行,同时保留处理新情况的灵活性。 目前的机器人系统为实现这一目标提供了互补优势。 愿景-行动模式[15、3、2、45]和世界行动模式[41、11、13]能够有效地控制机动车,但仍易受任务和场景变化的影响[46、30]。 通过模仿学习来适应它们,往往需要收集许多额外的人类演示,使持续获得技能的成本高昂。 基金会-模型代理人可以借鉴广泛的前科知识,不熟悉情况的理由,并援引机器人控制API来发现和完善解决方案[21,10,44,43]. 然而,重复推理,工具使用,以及修复都引入了耐久性和API成本,限制了日常行为对代理执行的依赖.

blocks.en: Realizing this progression requires a reciprocal learning loop between an agent’s harness —its executable skills, memory, and orchestration—and its low-level policy. Harness-centered recursive self-improvement methods refine programs and accumulate experience through feedback [ 9 , 20 , 32 , 35 ] , but keeping the motor policy fixed does not transfer newly acquired skills into the learned controller. Policy-centered methods use foundation models to guide autonomous data collection and improve learned controllers [ 12 , 47 , 23 ] , but do not jointly adapt the harness to the controller’s changing abilities. Co-evolution must therefore connect learning efficient policy behaviors from harness discoveries with adapting the harness to the improving policy . This reciprocity is essential because policy improvement changes both the motor skills available to the agent and the failures that still require exploration and repair.
blocks.zh: 实现这一进步需要在代理人的利用——其可执行的技能、记忆和管弦乐——及其低级政策之间有一个相互的学习循环。 以机理为核心的递归自我改进方法通过反馈来完善程序并积累经验[9,20,32,35],但保持运动政策固定不会将新获得的技能转移到学习控制器. 以政策为中心的方法使用基础模型来指导自主数据收集,改进学习的控制器[12,47,23],但并不共同使控制器适应控制器不断变化的能力. 因此,共同演变必须把学习有效的政策行为从利用发现与调整利用与改进政策联系起来。 这种对等关系至关重要,因为改进政策既改变了代理人掌握的机动技能,也改变了仍然需要探索和维修的故障。

blocks.en: We introduce RoboEvo 2 , a framework for recursive harness–policy co-evolution that uses current-policy failures to drive both updates ( ). In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, a coding agent diagnoses failures, discovers verified corrections, and consolidates them into reusable skills, routing strategies, and persistent memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, successful trajectories and matched failure–correction pairs teach the policy to reproduce effective corrections and disfavor failed alternatives. The updated policy then supplies stronger motor skills for subsequent agentic search, while its remaining failures redirect harness refinement. Concurrent studies also investigate harness–policy coupling [ 7 , 4 , 36 , 34 ] . RoboEvo 2 connects failure-guided, multi-route solution discovery with explicit learning from matched failures and corrections, progressively reducing repeated agentic intervention as acquired skills are internalized into the policy.
blocks.zh: 我们引入RoboEvo 2, 即一个循环利用的框架, 在Policy to-Harness(P2H)演化中,一个编码代理诊断失败,发现经过验证的校正,并将其整合为可重复使用的技能,路由策略,以及持续的内存. 在Harness-to-Policy(H2P)演化中,成功的轨迹和匹配的故障-校正对子教导政策重现有效的校正和失败的选项。 更新后的政策为随后的代理搜索提供了更强的机动技能,而其余的失败则重新调整了对机车的改进。 同时进行的研究还调查了利用-政策结合[7、4、36、34]。 机器人 Evo 2将故障制导的多路解决方案发现与从对应的故障和矫正中明确学习联系起来,随着获得的技能被内化到政策中,逐渐减少重复的代理干预.

blocks.en: First, to discover complementary capabilities, we develop a failure-conditioned, multi-route P2H repair engine. For each policy failure, it searches three solution routes in parallel: Code refines control programs, Code+ICL incorporates demonstration guidance, and Code+Policy composes programs with learned motor skills. Execution feedback drives iterative repair, and the successful candidate with the lowest normalized motion jerk is selected under matched conditions. This design combines complementary control capabilities to generate verified, smooth corrections targeted at current policy weaknesses.
blocks.zh: 首先,为了发现互补能力,我们开发了一台故障式多路P2H修理引擎. 对于每次政策失败,它同时搜索三个解决方案路径: 代码完善了控制程序,代码+ICL包含了演示指导,代码+政策则由学习过运动技能的程序组成. 执行反馈驱动迭代修补,成功的候选人与最低常态运动混蛋在相应条件下被选中. 这种设计结合了互补的控制能力,以产生针对当前政策弱点的经核实的、顺利的纠正。

blocks.en: Second, to internalize corrective capabilities, we introduce Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD). CPD pairs failed and corrected continuations from the same starting state and optimizes a margin between their action-prediction losses relative to a frozen reference policy. Asymmetric proximity penalties discourage degradation of corrective behaviors and excessive suppression of failed alternatives. Combined with supervised learning on verified trajectories, CPD teaches both which corrections to reproduce and which failed alternatives to disfavor. Failure-aware sampling and continual-learning regularization support targeted acquisition and capability retention.
blocks.zh: 第二,为了将纠正能力内部化,我们引入了反事实偏好分化(CPD). CPD配对失败并纠正了同一起始状态的续作,优化了与冻结参考政策相比的行动预测损失的幅度。 不对称的近距离处罚阻止了矫正行为的退化和过度压制失败的替代品。 国家方案文件与对经核实的轨迹的有监督的学习相结合,既教那些要复制的校正,又教那些没有办法不满意的。 未能意识到的抽样和持续学习的正规化支助有针对性地获得和能力保留。

blocks.en: Third, to sustain iterative capability reuse, we develop a harness update mechanism coupled with policy reuse across rounds. Compatible repairs update executable skills and routing logic, while persistent memory retains failure contexts, attempted solutions, and validated guidance. The updated policy then drives subsequent rollouts and participates in Code+Policy search, changing both the failures requiring exploration and the motor primitives available for repair. This closes the reciprocal loop: accumulated harness knowledge supports correction discovery, while internalized policy capabilities directly support subsequent search.
blocks.zh: 第三,为了维持迭代能力的再利用,我们开发了一种利用更新机制,并辅之以政策上的再利用。 兼容修复更新可执行技能和路由逻辑,而持续的内存保留故障上下文,尝试解决方案,并验证指导. 更新后的政策推动随后推出并参与代码+政策搜索,既改变需要探索的故障,也改变可供修复的发动机原始. 这关闭了对等循环:积累的利用知识支持矫正发现,而内化的政策能力直接支持后续的搜索.

blocks.en: Experiments demonstrate recursive adaptation to distribution shifts without additional human demonstrations. Across eight rounds on LIBERO-PRO [ 46 ] and five rounds on RoboTwin C2R [ 5 ] , standalone success improves from 11.0% to 84.1% and 46.0% to 77.5%, respectively, with hybrid success reaching 90.5% and 87.4% alongside reduced agentic API expenditure. On RoboTwin C2R, our method with 7.5K trajectories matches conventional training with 27.5K trajectories. Ablations validate reciprocal co-evolution, complementary solution routes in P2H, and counterfactual preference distillation in H2P. We further demonstrate autonomous task acquisition on MolmoSpaces [ 16 ] and cross-embodiment harness transfer. On the Unitree G1-D, a simulation-evolved harness enables the collection of 120 demonstrations, yielding 85.0% standalone success compared with 80.0% using 200 human demonstrations, while fixed-harness hybrid execution reaches 95.0%.
blocks.zh: 实验表明,在不进行额外的人类演示的情况下,对分布变化的循环适应。 在LIBERO-PRO[46]和RoboTwin C2R[5]的五轮比赛中,独立成功率分别从11.0%增至84.1%和46.0%至77.5%,混合成功率分别达到90.5%和87.4%,同时减少了代理API支出。 在RoboTwin C2R上,我们用7.5K轨距的方法将常规训练与27.5K轨距匹配. 缩写验证对等共演化,P2H中的互补溶液途径,以及H2P中的反事实偏好蒸馏. 我们进一步展示了MolmoSpaces[16]上的自主任务和交叉化的机床转移。 在Unitree G1-D上,一个模拟-演化的牵引装置能够收集120个演示,与使用200个人类演示的80.0%相比,独立成功率达到85.0%,而固定强度混合执行率为95.0%。

blocks.en: 4.1 Generalization and Multi-Round Evolution

blocks.en: We evaluate RoboEvo 2 on two benchmarks under distribution shifts. LIBERO-PRO [ 46 ] transfers policies trained on original LIBERO demonstrations to task and position perturbations, while RoboTwin C2R [ 5 ] adapts policies trained on 2,500 clean demonstrations to randomized scenes across 50 bimanual tasks. On both benchmarks, evolution runs on seeds held out from the initial training data without additional human annotation, and generalization is evaluated on separate unseen seeds (800 LIBERO-PRO and 5,000 RoboTwin C2R episodes; Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价RoboEvo 2在分配上的两个基准。 LIBERO-PRO[46] 将训练有素的最初LIBERO示威的政策用于任务和定位扰动,而RoboTwin C2R[5]则将训练有素的2500个清洁演示的政策适用于50个双人任务中的随机场景. 在这两个基准上,进化是在没有附加人类注释的情况下从初步培训数据中抽取的种子上进行的,在单独的隐形种子(800个LIBERO-PRO和5 000个RoboTwin C2R集;附录D)上评价一般化。

blocks.en: Multi-Round Adaptation and Data Efficiency. Figure 3 demonstrates progressive improvements in standalone and hybrid execution. On LIBERO-PRO, eight rounds improve standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5%, while API expenditure decreases from $430.63 to $98.92. On RoboTwin C2R, five rounds increase standalone success from 46.0% to 77.5% and hybrid success from 48.8% to 87.4%, with API expenditure decreasing from $719.05 to $323.84. These results demonstrate sustained capability improvement alongside decreasing agentic costs, highlighting the benefits of recursive harness–policy co-evolution.
blocks.zh: 多径适应与数据效率. 图3显示独立执行和混合执行方面的逐步改进。 在LIBERO-PRO方面,八轮单打成功率从11.0%提高到84.1%,混合成功率从30.4%下降到90.5%,而API支出从430.63美元下降到98.92美元。 在RoboTwin C2R上,5轮将独立成功率从46.0%提高到77.5%,混合成功率从48.8%提高到87.4%,API支出从719.05美元下降到323.84美元. 这些结果表明,在减少代理成本的同时,持续的能力得到提高,这凸显了循环利用政策共同演变的好处。

blocks.en: Beyond execution efficiency, RoboEvo 2 acquires training experience without additional human demonstrations. As shown in Tab. 1 , starting from 2,500 clean demonstrations, our framework autonomously collects 5,000 verified trajectories and achieves 77.5% standalone success on RoboTwin C2R. With the same 7.5K trajectories, clean+random training reaches only 67.2%, and it needs 27.5K to reach 76.8%. RoboEvo 2 thus matches it with only 27.3% of the training data, suggesting that failure-driven experience provides effective supervision.

blocks.en: Comparison with Self-Evolving Methods. Table 2 compares RoboEvo 2 with recent self-evolving robot systems. Harness-centered methods, including ASPIRE [ 26 ] , Zetta [ 9 ] , DynaHarness [ 8 ] , and EmbodiedRSI [ 32 ] , primarily improve executable skills and agentic recovery. In contrast, RoboEvo 2 enables reciprocal evolution, where harness discoveries provide corrective supervision for policy learning, while the updated policy supplies stronger motor primitives and guides subsequent harness search. Across all eight LIBERO-PRO settings, RoboEvo 2 achieves 84.1% standalone and 90.5% hybrid success, surpassing EmbodiedRSI’s 86.8% hybrid success. Further PPO refinement increases standalone and hybrid success to 94.8% and 96.8%, respectively. These results demonstrate competitive adaptation performance while progressively internalizing agent-discovered capabilities into the policy.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented RoboEvo 2 , a framework for failure-driven recursive harness–policy co-evolution. Through complementary solution discovery (P2H) and counterfactual capability internalization (H2P), verified agentic corrections become reusable harness skills and learned policy behaviors. Across rounds, the improved policy provides stronger motor primitives and redirects subsequent harness exploration, closing the reciprocal learning loop. Experiments demonstrate progressive improvements in standalone and hybrid execution with reduced agentic costs, alongside data-efficient adaptation, autonomous task acquisition, cross-embodiment reuse, and real-world policy learning. RoboEvo 2 thus supports progressive policy autonomy while retaining agentic capabilities for unresolved challenges.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了RoboEvo 2, 即一个失败驱动的循环利用框架, 通过互补的解决方案发现(P2H)和反事实能力内部化(H2P),经核实的代理校正成为可重复使用的驾驭技能和学到的政策行为. 在各个回合中,经过改进的政策提供了更强大的运动原始,并重新引导后来的利用探索,关闭了对等的学习循环. 实验表明,在独立和混合执行方面,随着数据高效的适应、自主任务获取、跨化再利用和现实世界的政策学习,逐步改进了代理成本。 机器人 因此,Evo 2支持逐步的政策自主,同时保留处理尚未解决的挑战的代理能力。

Appendix H Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录H 限制

blocks.en: RoboEvo 2 composes and revises skills on top of a fixed set of atomic skills and perception tools, which do not yet cover capabilities such as force-controlled contact or in-hand regrasping. Future work can enlarge this initial library with such primitives, which the agent can then compose and revise like the existing ones. A task-level success check selects the executions that train the policy; the VLM check that repaired skills already use could replace it, at the cost of extra model calls.
blocks.zh: RoboEvo 2在一组固定的原子技能和感知工具之上作曲和修改技能,这些技能和感知工具尚不涵盖武力控制的接触或手动重塑等能力. 未来的工作可以用这种原始物来扩充这个初始的库,然后代理物可以像现有的原始物一样来作曲和修改. 任务级别的成功检查会选择训练政策的执行;修复已经使用的技能的VLM检查可以取代它,而代价是额外的模型调用.
